name: ApiGatewayApplication
description: Main Spring Boot application class that bootstraps the API Gateway

methods.name: main
methods.description: Main entry point of the application that starts the Spring Boot API Gateway

name: GatewayConfig
description: Configuration class for setting up API gateway routes and global filters

methods.name: routeLocator
methods.description: Defines the route configurations for the API gateway

methods.name: corsConfiguration
methods.description: Configures CORS settings for the API gateway

name: RequestFilter
description: Interface for handling API request filtering

methods.name: getFilter
methods.description: Returns a gateway filter implementation

methods.name: getOrder
methods.description: Returns the order of this filter in the filter chain

name: AuthenticationFilter
description: Global filter for handling authentication of incoming requests

fields.name: skipAuthPaths
fields.description: List of paths that don't require authentication

methods.name: getFilter
methods.description: Returns a filter that verifies authentication token in requests

methods.name: getOrder
methods.description: Returns the order of this filter in the filter chain

methods.name: shouldSkipAuth
methods.description: Determines if a path should skip authentication

name: LoggingFilter
description: Global filter for logging request and response details

fields.name: logger
fields.description: Logger for recording request and response details

fields.name: includeHeaders
fields.description: Flag to determine if headers should be included in logs

fields.name: includePayload
fields.description: Flag to determine if payload should be included in logs

methods.name: getFilter
methods.description: Returns a filter that logs request and response details

methods.name: getOrder
methods.description: Returns the order of this filter in the filter chain

methods.name: logRequest
methods.description: Logs details of the incoming request

methods.name: logResponse
methods.description: Logs details of the outgoing response

name: RateLimiter
description: Interface for implementing API rate limiting functionality

methods.name: isAllowed
methods.description: Determines if a request is allowed based on rate limiting rules

methods.name: getKey
methods.description: Generates a key for rate limiting based on the request

name: RequestRateLimiter
description: Implementation of rate limiting functionality for API requests

fields.name: requestsPerSecond
fields.description: Number of requests allowed per second

methods.name: isAllowed
methods.description: Checks if a request is allowed based on rate limiting configuration

methods.name: getKey
methods.description: Generates a key for rate limiting based on IP address or user ID

methods.name: getRateLimitResponse
methods.description: Creates a response for when rate limit is exceeded

fields.name: serviceDefinitions
fields.description: List of service definitions for API documentation

methods.name: getSwaggerResources
methods.description: Returns a list of Swagger resources for all services

methods.name: getSwaggerUiConfig
methods.description: Returns configuration for Swagger UI

methods.name: getSwaggerSecurityConfiguration
methods.description: Returns security configuration for Swagger

name: RoutesConfiguration
description: Configuration class defining the routing rules for different service endpoints

methods.name: productServiceRoutes
methods.description: Configures routes for product service

methods.name: orderServiceRoutes
methods.description: Configures routes for order service

methods.name: paymentServiceRoutes
methods.description: Configures routes for payment service

methods.name: notificationServiceRoutes
methods.description: Configures routes for notification service

name: GlobalErrorHandler
description: Global error handler for managing exceptions in the API gateway

fields.name: objectMapper
fields.description: Jackson object mapper for JSON serialization

methods.name: handle
methods.description: Handles exceptions and returns appropriate error responses

methods.name: renderErrorResponse
methods.description: Creates a standardized error response for different types of exceptions
